scope: Bounded arithmetic calibration in one fixed integral flat-hook family. Rank specialization and the greedy-minimum criterion are classical. No asymptotic growth inference or new specialization theorem is claimed.

length_102_specialization.criterion: In a finite free integral algebra with an integral monomial reference basis, the labelled positive fan changes precisely at prime divisors of determinants of rationally coherent bases. This does not imply that the number of cones changes at every such prime.
